{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Oh, {01 00 00 14 00}I haven't been clothes
shopping in the LONGEST
time. {01 00 00 0a 00}But I'm broke, see?
{07 16 00}If only someone would just
give me some.{01 01 00} {07 11 00}Yes,
"someone," {04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 0e 00}Lately,{01 00 00 05 00} whether I'm sleeping{01 00 00 05 00}
or awake,{01 00 00 05 00} all I can think 
about are clothes{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}If you see a hot piece of
clothing,{01 00 00 05 00} {07 14 00}would you let
me know?
{07 0a 00}And for your trouble, {01 00 00 05 00}I'll
give you one of my super-
special smiles!

{07 14 00}I want to transform my
look from head to toe {01 00 00 0a 00}and
hit the town!
{07 0d 00}Just thinking about it gets
me all excited,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}But first,{01 00 00 05 00} I need to get 
the new clothes{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
